title: RepoMesh Repository Assignment Package v1
description: Response of GET /api/v1/agent-actions/leader/assignments/{taskId}. The server-provided fact package a Repository Leader plans and reviews from. The server supplies facts, the safety envelope, and non-authoritative hints; it never authors the leader's Engineering Spec, DAG, or worker tasks. Phase invariants (enforced by the producer, pinned by contract tests): reviewEvidence is null while phase is planning or executing, and non-null when phase is review_due or closed.

phase.description: planning: no plan accepted yet, POST /plan is open. executing: plan accepted, worker tasks in flight. review_due: all worker tasks terminal, POST /review is open. closed: leader task reached a terminal status.

repositoryTask.description: The repository-level task as assigned by the Organization Manager. Facts, not hints.

workerRoster.description: The team's workers. Plan assignees must be drawn from this roster; anything else is plan_invalid_assignee.

allowedPathRoots.description: Clamp bound: every allowedPaths entry of every worker task in the plan must fall under one of these roots.

testCommands.description: Clamp bound: every worker task's tests must include every command listed here; dropping one is plan_invalid_tests_removed.

safetyEnvelope.description: Server-derived hard bounds the plan is validated against. The envelope constrains the plan; it does not write it.

authoritative.description: Always false. Everything in this object is a hint the leader may ignore; nothing in it is validated against or clamped to.

dependencyEdges.description: Cross-repository dependency facts from discovery: downstream depends on upstream.

reviewEvidence.description: null until review_due. In review_due/closed: the immutable evidence package the review verdict must be based on.

reviewRevision.description: 1 for the first review round; incremented each time request_rework produces a new round. The revision a review decision is accepted against is part of its idempotent identity.

status.description: Terminal-or-resting statuses only; review_due fires when no worker task is still assigned/in_progress.

runId.description: null when the task never produced a run.

commitSha.description: null when the run produced no commit.
